reviews.t: Perfumey floral scent was a no-go for me
reviews.x: I honestly didn't even use it before sending it back. Ive always had a sensitivity to strong perfumey smells (to this day I can still only go into Bath & Body Works, Abercrombie, Hollister, etc for a very brief moment before I get a headache and start feeling nauseous) and smelling just a little bit of this lotion on my finger made me feel like I couldn't imagine being covered in it. So if you're sensitive to perfumey/foral scented products I definitely do not recommend this lotion.

reviews.t: Not a fan of your IT list lotion.
reviews.x: 2nd purchase this tanning lotion, however this time around it is not the same as the original purchase. I just started using it as I ran out of my first bottle. This bottle is way to runny and worst part is that it is actually causing me to have a allergic reaction which it should not be doing as it's supposedly hypoallergenic. I just can't continue using this bottle. Will look into purchasing again but not from your company. There is something just not right with your IT lotion.

reviews.t: A very good NUT FREE tanning bed lotion!
reviews.x: I bought this for my wife to use when she lays in a tanning bed.  She has very bad food allergies and in particular, nut allergies.  If there's even a hint of any kind of nut or fruit of any kind in a skin product, she will have some type of terrible reaction.  This is literally the ONLY tanning bed lotion I could find that doesn't have any type of dam nut or ridiculous fruit extract in it!  And that doesn't cost a fortune, let alone cause her to have a bad allergic reaction. I put some on just

I was a bit skeptical with the affordability.  I was looking for a vegan friendly indoor tanning lotion and I figured, why not!?  Man, this didn't let me down.  It smells great and has wonderful hydration!  I also only use indoor tanning maybe 5 minutes at a time, so I was hoping this would help me attain and sustain some color even though normally it would take my skin a while to tan.  I saw color within only 2-3 sessions (and Im not talking red sunburn either).  I was able to also sustain the

This stuff works!  When I was younger I had no problem tanning.  I would rarely burn and would tan within days. It seems the older I get the harder it is to get a good tan.  I bought this stuff and after just two uses I have a pretty good base tan!  The lotion smells great and doesn't stain my skin.  I will most definitely order this lotion again.

So, I've tanned in the past and it's quite easy for me being that I don't burn easily. I don't love tanning or even lay out, but i'll be going to an island in a couple of months and wanted to get a base at least so I don't burn with the sun intensity down there.  I wanted a vegan/cruelty free indoor tanning lotion and this one had the best reviews. I'm not unhappy with it by any means, but I'm not head over heels either, which disappointed me. The smell is great, consistency is nice - not too oi

reviews.t: Love this lotion for indoor tanning!!!
reviews.x: My daughter and I have very sensitive skin and this smells great and it moisturizes your skin. My daughter and I have very sensitive skin and this smells great and it moisturizes your skin.  I have tried many other kinds of lotions.  This one is great.  I can’t wear makeup but can put this on and it doesn’t bother me.

I typically buy this lotion from the tanning salon, but thought I would give it a try buying it online and it was the exact product I thought it was!! Love the way it makes me smell after tanning, and the way it makes my skin feel after using for a few weeks!

I have been using this for a few weeks and it works perfectly. No dry skin or peeling at all. The only thing is it done not smell too great...but that does not really matter since I always shower after tanning anyway.
Good lotion, really like it, have skin allergies and so far this is the only lotion I can use.

I love this product.  It goes on thin and a little goes a long way.  It’s not thick and goopy like other tanning lotions.  It smells fantastic, and putting it on is refreshing.  Already had a base tan, and only tanned 2x with it so still unsure of the tanning benefits.  But it still smells wonderful after tanning.  If you’re looking for a lotion that has light fragrance, this isn’t for you.  But for those of you who LIKE fragrance, I wish I could find a perfume like this.

reviews.t: Luxuruous, moisturizing, excellent for dry/sensitive skin, allergies & affordable
reviews.x: I absolutely LOVE this product! Great for dry skin, sensitive skin, allergies.  I'd tried a sample pack @ least 3 X's in my tanning salon to make sure I liked it & to see how I reacted. I was tan, super moisturized, lightly scented & for the 1St time did NOT have an itch or rash or break out. I was warned against buying on Amazon but for $12 it was worth every penny. Can't wait to purchase again!

reviews.t: Now that I've started using this product, I am ...
reviews.x: Now that I've started using this product, I am a huge star.  Everywhere I go the media is there to ask me how I've done it, and what I'll do next.  "The It List" won't just work for me, you can join me in my new found fame.  That...or it's a tanning lotion and makes your skin softish.  That person talking about the strong odor has a crazy nose, this stuff is mildly scented.
I'm allergic to all fragrances and dyes so I was leery when I bought this cause it has a scent but I surprisingly never broke out
I did not have much luck with this. I bronze better without it.
Love it. Does exactly what it says it's going to do!!!

reviews.t: This stuff is ok but not great
reviews.x: The best thing about it is the scent. It really smells good and not like most tanning products that smell like someone spilled a pina colada. Its not oily or greasy and moisturizes fairly well. It is also streak-free. However, it does help that much with the tanning process. My results are not noticeable between using this lotion and not using anything at all. I almost feel like using regular, SPF free, hand lotion is more effective.

reviews.t: Deep tan and a subtle scent
reviews.x: Loved this lotion, have bought it twice now. I have had so many compliments on my deep tan after starting to use this lotion. I have very sensitive skin and a lot of allergies and have had a lot of success with this lotion. I love that it's a soft scent instead of a strong perfume like scent I've had with other lotions.

This stuff smells so good! Even my boyfriend said he could smell it after I came out of the tanning bed and commented on how wonderful it smells. I feel like it’s not super greasy or anything like that and absorbs into the skin rather quickly. I’ve only used it a few times and gotten some pretty nice color with it too.

I love this product because I have sensitive skin which is easily irritated. I can use The It List with confidence that it won't disturbed my sensitive skin. I have a natural looking tan and it doesn't dry out my skin. I highly recommend this product.

Good lotion! Actually smells good and is light. Provides great moisture to the skin. Definitely a good lotion for the price. They slab a barcode sticker right on the front of the bottle and the bottle looked scratched up but there was tap on the cap.

I really like using this lotion. I feel is worth its price. I am very pale, fair, sensitive skin and was showing color after just a few sessions. I really like that it doesn't smell like burnt skin after tanning too. I would buy it again.

reviews.t: Moisturizing and good for sensitive skin
reviews.x: Smells amazing and is one of the only tanning lotions I can use with my sensitive skin. I used to get hives all over my body with literally any other tanning lotion until I got this one. The scent is very subtle and nice.

I go tanning at a new place and have bad allergies. I got thos stuff at my old tanning salon and the new one doesn't have it. They have something close to it they say and it has a bad smell and turns you orange.
I wanted a tanning lotion without bronzers, but I honestly am not sure this did anything. I tanned just as much in areas without it. I switched to Ed Hardy blonde and got tan a lot faster

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the scent, describing it as great, wonderful, or refreshing.
Reviewers with sensitive skin or allergies report that this lotion works well for them without causing reactions.
Several reviewers highlight good hydration and moisturizing benefits, with no dry skin or peeling.
A few reviewers report negative reactions, including a strong perfumey scent and an allergic reaction or runny consistency.
Some reviewers note mixed or limited tanning results, with one saying they bronze better without it.
